svg.title: About me
svg.desc:
I'm a student learning Python and JavaScript. I like having a project to try things out on while I learn.
Right now I'm working on OmniArchive and dangerous assault. I switch between the two depending on what I feel like building.
When I'm away from the editor, I'm usually listening to music or playing games. If you want to talk projects or games, you can reach me on Telegram.
